android.desc:
The Barcode Document Verification application allows you to easily verify documents you receive from www.turkiye.gov.tr ​​(e-Government Gateway).

You can quickly verify documents containing QR codes, such as criminal records, student records, graduation certificates, service records, etc.

How Does It Work?
Our application offers two different methods to simplify the document verification process:

QR Code Reading: The QR code on your document is automatically verified by scanning it from the menu. It's a fast and error-free method.

Manual Entry: You can complete the verification process by entering the barcode number on the document and secondary verification information based on the document type into the application.
